briefs.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original illustrated ending scene for a children's Faraday science adventure browser game. Create a beautiful landscape 3:2 illustration, 1536x1024, painterly storybook realism with polished hand-painted game-art finish, not a photograph. London Royal Institution lecture room around 1860. An elderly Michael Faraday, recognizable swept silver-white hair, clean shaven, dark nineteenth-century frock coat and waistcoat with white shirt and neckcloth, kindly and attentively demonstrating ONE lit wax candle on a plain brass candlestick on a wooden table to a small audience of curious children and teenagers in historically appropriate mid nineteenth-century clothing, girls and boys seated a safe distance on wooden benches. Faraday stands behind the table, gesturing beside the small candle flame without touching it, looking at his listeners. The candle and his expressive face and hands are the focal point; a notebook and simple glass vessel stand aside on the table. Warm amber candle glow balanced with soft cool teal-blue window light, deep indigo shadows and aged brass highlights to match a thoughtful science adventure. Clear readable central triangular composition, about five children visible, gentle hopeful emotionally satisfying epilogue. Believable proportions and hands; restrained room details, no clutter. This is an imagined illustration of a historical science lecture, not an exact reproduction of any existing painting. No aircraft, dragons, weapons, crowns, academic robes, medals, electricity arcs, magical effects, modern lab equipment, modern school clothes, text, writing, logos or watermarks. Draw the whole scene edge to edge, no frame. Keep the teacher, candle and children's faces comfortably inside the central 85 percent so the image is readable on phone screens.
